title: Neon Snake Retro
description: Classic snake with fluid neon visuals, speed scaling, sound synthesis, and multiple food types.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move. Space to pause.

title: Block Matrix (Tetris)
description: The quintessential falling tetromino puzzle. Features ghost piece, hold queue, hard drop, and combo scoring.
controls: Left/Right to move, Up/X to rotate, Down to soft drop, Space to hard drop, C to hold.

title: 2048 Super
description: Join the numbers to get to the 2048 tile! Features undo moves, smooth animations, and high score tracking.
controls: Arrow keys or swipe on mobile to slide tiles.

title: Flappy Pixel Bird
description: Tap or press space to flap your wings and navigate through pipes without crashing. How high can you score?
controls: Spacebar, Up Arrow, or Click/Tap to flap.

title: Galaxy Defender
description: Defend Earth against advancing alien armadas! Features defensive bunkers, mystery motherships, and power-ups.
controls: A/D or Left/Right to move, Space to fire cannon.

title: Cyber Breakout
description: Smash all bricks with the energetic sphere. Catch falling power-ups like multi-ball, laser paddle, and mega beam.
controls: Mouse movement or Left/Right arrows to control paddle.

title: Cyber Pong 2088
description: The arcade classic updated with dynamic curves, synth sound fx, 1-Player vs AI mode, and 2-Player local battle.
controls: W/S for Player 1, Up/Down for Player 2 (or against AI).

title: Desert T-Rex Runner
description: Jump cacti and duck under flying pterodactyls in this endless runner with day-night cycles and escalating speed.
controls: Space/Up to jump, Down to duck.

title: Minesweeper Deluxe
description: Uncover safe cells and flag hidden naval mines using pure logic. Includes Easy, Medium, and Expert grids.
controls: Left click to reveal, Right click or Flag Mode to place flags.

title: Neon Tower Stacker
description: Time your block drops with precision to stack an endless skyscraper. Perfect alignments reward combo multipliers!
controls: Spacebar or Click anywhere to drop block.

title: Asteroid Vector Zone
description: Pilot your spacecraft in zero gravity, blast incoming space boulders, and dodge flying alien saucers.
controls: Left/Right to rotate, Up to thrust, Space to shoot, Down to hyperspace.

title: Connect Four Challenge
description: Drop colored discs into the grid and be the first to connect 4 in a line. Play vs intelligent AI or local friend.
controls: Click columns 1-7 or use keys 1-7 to drop disc.
